title: packet-json: move away from `wmem_packet_scope()`
description:
As requested [here][1], use of `wmem_packet_scope()` is discouraged in
favour of `pinfo->pool`. Achieve this in the JSON dissector by passing a
`pool` argument to helper functions, and get that pool from the
`packet_info` member of `tvbparse_data`.

[1]: https://www.wireshark.org/lists/wireshark-dev/202107/msg00052.html
